name: Ikemen Oukyuu ◆ Mayonaka no Cinderella
original_name: イケメン王宮◆真夜中のシンデレラ
source:
You, a commoner, have now become princess of the entire country of Wysteria! The first job as "princess" is to find the prince who will rule beside you. You soon find yourself surrounded with a cast of nine highly eligible bachelors... However, you can only pick one! Who will rule beside you at the throne?!

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.cybird.appli.android.oqs.en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你原本只是平民，如今却成为整个维斯特利亚王国的公主！作为“公主”的第一项工作，是找到将与你并肩统治的王子。很快，你发现自己被九名条件极佳的单身男性包围……然而，你只能选择一人！谁会与你一起登上王座？！

[来源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.cybird.appli.android.oqs.en]Google Play[/url]]
